body:
## Summary

uv appears unable to retrieve Azure Artifacts credentials from `artifacts-keyring` when using:

```cmd
set UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess
set UV_INDEX_COMPANY_PYTHON_FEED_USERNAME=VssSessionToken
```

The `artifacts-keyring` backend is installed and functional. Direct keyring access successfully acquires and returns an Azure Artifacts token, but `uv pip install` still fails with `401 Unauthorized`.

## Environment

```text
uv 0.13.9
Windows
Azure Artifacts feed
artifacts-keyring installed via uv tool
```

## Configuration

`uv.toml`

```toml
[[index]]
name = "company-python-feed"
url = "https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/cmpany-python-feed/pypi/simple/"

[[index]]
name = "pypi"
url = "https://pypi.org/simple"
default = true
```

Environment variables:

```cmd
set UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess
set UV_INDEX_COMPANY_PYTHON_FEED_USERNAME=VssSessionToken
```

## Install keyring

```cmd
uv tool install keyring --with artifacts-keyring
```

Verify backend registration:

```cmd
uv tool run keyring --list-backends
```

Output:

```text
keyring.backends.fail.Keyring (priority: 0)
keyring.backends.chainer.ChainerBackend (priority: 10)
artifacts_keyring.ArtifactsKeyringBackend (priority: 9.9)
keyring.backends.Windows.WinVaultKeyring (priority: 5)
```

This indicates that `ArtifactsKeyringBackend` is installed and active.

## Direct keyring access works

Running:

```cmd
uv tool run keyring get https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/compay-python-feed/pypi/simple/ VssSessionToken
```

opens an Azure authentication browser flow the first time.

After successful login it returns an access token.

Subsequent invocations immediately return the cached token.

Therefore:

- Azure authentication succeeds
- artifacts-keyring can retrieve credentials
- token storage works

## uv still fails

Running:

```cmd
uv pip install --dry-run package-name -vv
```

fails with:

```text
401 Unauthorized
```

Relevant trace:

```text
TRACE No password in cache for URL
https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/

TRACE No password in cache for realm
VssSessionToken@https://pkgs.dev.azure.com

DEBUG Checking keyring for credentials for index URL
VssSessionToken@https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/

TRACE Checking keyring for URL
https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/

TRACE Checking keyring for host pkgs.dev.azure.com

TRACE Received response for fresh request with status 401 Unauthorized
```

Final error:

```text
error: No solution found when resolving dependencies

hint: An index URL
(https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/)
could not be queried due to a lack of valid authentication credentials (401 Unauthorized)
```

## Additional observations

I verified that:

- `artifacts-keyring` is installed correctly.
- The Azure login flow works.
- The token is retrievable using `uv tool run keyring get ...`.
- Deleting `%APPDATA%\uv\credentials\credentials.toml` does not change behavior.
- The issue reproduces with a clean credentials store.
- `UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess` is honored by uv.

When keyring is disabled:

```cmd
set UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=disabled
```

the keyring lookup messages disappear from the verbose trace, indicating that uv is recognizing and applying the setting.

## Expected behavior

After:

```cmd
uv tool install keyring --with artifacts-keyring

set UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess
set UV_INDEX_COMPANY_PYTHON_FEED_USERNAME=VssSessionToken
```

uv should either:

1. Acquire Azure Artifacts credentials through `artifacts-keyring`, or
2. Reuse the token already obtainable through:

```cmd
uv tool run keyring get https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/ VssSessionToken
```

and successfully query the feed.

## Actual behavior

uv appears to invoke keyring, but no password/token is returned to uv and package resolution fails with:

```text
401 Unauthorized
```

despite the credential being available through direct keyring access.

## Reproduction steps

```cmd
uv tool install keyring --with artifacts-keyring

set UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess
set UV_INDEX_COMPANY_PYTHON_FEED_USERNAME=VssSessionToken

uv tool run keyring get https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/company/_packaging/company-python-feed/pypi/simple/ VssSessionToken

uv pip install --dry-run package-name -vv
```

The first command successfully authenticates and returns a token, while the final command fails with `401 Unauthorized`.
title: Azure Artifacts authentication via artifacts-keyring fails with `UV_KEYRING_PROVIDER=subprocess`
